description: Cornea, conjunctiva, tear film, and anterior chamber — infectious keratitis, dystrophies, ectasias, cross-linking, endothelial disorders, and anterior chamber grading.

episodes.title: Corneal Anatomy: The Five Layers and Why Each Matters
episodes.description:
What if the clearest thing in your body is also the most complex? In this episode of Focus Cast, we take a deep dive into the cornea, the transparent, dome-shaped structure at the front of your eye that accounts for two-thirds of your total focusing power. And we are not just scratching the surface.

We break down all five distinct layers of the cornea, from the self-renewing epithelium that rebuilds itself every seven days, to the precisely organized stroma that makes transparency physically possible, to the endothelium, a single layer of irreplaceable cells working around the clock to keep your vision clear. Along the way, we explore Bowman's layer and why LASIK permanently alters it, the remarkable resilience of Descemet's membrane, and the fascinating story behind Dua's layer, a fifth corneal layer that scientists only formally identified in 2013.

Whether you wear contact lenses, have ever considered laser eye surgery, or simply want to understand the biology behind everyday vision, this episode gives you a front-row seat to one of the most extraordinary structures in the human body.

By the end, you will never think about blinking the same way again.

Listen now and share this episode with anyone who loves exploring the science of the human body. For more content on eye health and vision science, visit us at focuslinks.in.

episodes.title: Epithelium: The First Barrier and Its Common Failures
episodes.description: Abrasions, erosions, and the recurrent erosion syndrome that follows seemingly minor trauma.

episodes.title: Bowman’s Layer: Where Scars Begin
episodes.description: Why superficial keratectomy matters and how trauma here leaves permanent opacities.

episodes.title: Stroma: Collagen Architecture and Edema Mechanics
episodes.description: How stromal lamellae maintain transparency and the osmotic forces that cause corneal swelling.

episodes.title: Descemet’s Membrane and Endothelium: The Pump That Keeps the Cornea Clear
episodes.description: Endothelial pump function, guttae, and why counting cells changes the management plan.

episodes.title: Bacterial Keratitis: The Ulcer at the Slit Lamp
episodes.description: Differentiating bacterial from fungal and Acanthamoeba — the morphological clues that guide empiric therapy.

episodes.title: Fungal Keratitis: Feathery Edges and Satellite Lesions
episodes.description: Recognizing fungal morphology, the risk factors of trauma and contact lens wear, and the referral threshold.

episodes.title: Acanthamoeba Keratitis: The Ring and the Agony
episodes.description: The ring infiltrate, disproportionate pain, and why early diagnosis is the only chance to save the eye.

episodes.title: Herpes Simplex Keratitis: Dendrites, Disciform, and the Steroid Trap
episodes.description: Epithelial versus stromal HSV — the fluorescein staining pattern and the topical steroid decision.

episodes.title: Herpes Zoster Ophthalmicus: Hutchinson’s Sign and Beyond
episodes.description: Forehead vesicles, the nasociliary branch, and the ocular complications that demand slit lamp follow-up.

episodes.title: Corneal Dystrophies: Map-Dot-Fingerprint and Granular
episodes.description: The anterior and stromal dystrophies an optometrist will see — patterns, inheritance, and management.

episodes.title: Fuchs’ Endothelial Dystrophy: Guttae, Edema, and the Transplant Threshold
episodes.description: Morning blur, confluent guttae, and monitoring corneal thickness until DSAEK or DMEK becomes necessary.

episodes.title: Keratoconus: The Ectatic Cone and Early Detection
episodes.description: Topographic signs, fleischer ring, and the cross-linking referral that halts progression.

episodes.title: Corneal Cross-Linking: Halting the Ectatic Slide
episodes.description: The epi-off and epi-on protocols, what to expect during recovery, and post-CXL optometry care.

episodes.title: Pellucid Marginal Degeneration: The “Keratoconus Lookalike”
episodes.description: The inferior crab-claw topographic pattern and why standard contact lens fitting fails these patients.

episodes.title: Dry Eye and the Cornea: How Surface Disease Shapes the Exam
episodes.description: Punctate epithelial erosions, staining patterns, and how OSD changes every refraction.

episodes.title: Pterygium: The Wedge of Fibrovascular Tissue
episodes.description: Indications for excision, conjunctival autograft, and the recurrence risk that shapes the surgical decision.

episodes.title: Pinguecula: The Yellow Nodule That Is Not a Pterygium
episodes.description: Distinguishing pinguecula from pterygium, UV link, and the lubrication-first management.

episodes.title: Salzmann’s Nodular Degeneration: The Smooth Elevations
episodes.description: Recognizing the whitish nodules, the link to chronic surface disease, and the superficial keratectomy option.

episodes.title: Corneal Edema: Striae, Folds, and the “Ground Glass” Cornea
episodes.description: Distinguishing epithelial from stromal edema and tracing the cause to endothelium or IOP.

episodes.title: Corneal Foreign Body: Removal Techniques and Rust Ring
episodes.description: Burr versus needle, the rust ring that follows, and the antibiotic and cycloplegia that complete the visit.

episodes.title: Corneal Abrasion: The Scratch That Demands Care
episodes.description: Antibiotic choice, the contact lens wearer exception, and why cycloplegia transforms comfort overnight.

episodes.title: Recurrent Corneal Erosion: The Morning Tear-Out Syndrome
episodes.description: The history that clinches the diagnosis, hypertonic saline, and the bandage lens that breaks the cycle.

episodes.title: Chemical Burns: The Irrigation That Saves the Eye
episodes.description: Immediate, copious, continuous irrigation — the Morgan lens, the pH target, and the limbal ischemia grade.

episodes.title: Conjunctival Lesions: Nevus, Papilloma, and the Suspicious Mass
episodes.description: When to photograph, when to biopsy, and the features that escalate from observation to referral.

episodes.title: Corneal Topography: Reading the Color Map
episodes.description: Axial, tangential, and elevation maps — turning the color wheel into a clinical decision.

episodes.title: Specular Microscopy: Counting Endothelial Cells
episodes.description: When cell counts matter — IOL candidacy, glaucoma drops, and the pre-cataract assessment.

episodes.title: Anterior Segment OCT: Imaging What the Slit Lamp Misses
episodes.description: Using AS-OCT for angles, scleral lenses, and the corneal pathology that hides behind opacity.

episodes.title: Corneal Transplant: PKP, DSAEK, and DMEK for the Optometrist
episodes.description: Understanding the procedure, the post-op timeline, and the graft rejection signs you must catch.

episodes.title: Graft Rejection: The Khodadoust Line and Urgent Steroids
episodes.description: Recognizing the endothelial rejection line and the same-day steroid protocol that saves the graft.
